name: The Archivist
label: Quest
description: The Archivist: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, friend. Take for example, the Scarlet Crusade. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?

One in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of Stratholme: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Remember, friend - we must be tolerant yet rigid in our beliefs!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Outstanding, friend! Years of intelligence, lost! The Scarlet Crusade will surely feel this blow in the coming weeks.
